tool_input.description: Show git status and diff of all changes

tool_input.command:
git add io/www/src/fragment/transformers/settings.js io/www/test/fragment/settings.test.js studio/src/settings/mas-settings.js web-components/src/constants.js web-components/src/hydrate.js web-components/test/hydrate.test.js && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
feat(mas): add geo-tiered CTA mode toggle with hydrate-level swap

- Add ctaMode and learnMoreUrl settings definitions (io/settings transformer)
- Add CTA_MODE constants (buy-only, trial-only, default)
- Implement processCtaMode() in hydrate.js — suppresses conflicting CTAs,
  falls back to Learn More anchor when no compatible CTA remains
- Add sp-picker select editor support in MasSettings for enum-type settings
- Add unit tests for processCtaMode and new settings fields

Closes #6
EOF
)" && git status
tool_input.description: Stage relevant files and create commit
